summary: postmortem-maker reads an incident record from its live source via web.fetch, derives citable fragments from the fetched text, refuses any postmortem whose timeline or root cause quotes text that is not in the cited fragment, holds unknowns open instead of asserting them, and executes the authorised publish in the same run so the sealed receipt records a send that happened rather than a proposal. Harness is 4/4 green against real fetches and the dogfood receipt verifies valid.

observations.claim: Published to the runx registry as a community-tier package.
Installs clean from the registry into an empty directory.
Package harness passes all four cases with zero assertion errors against real web.fetch calls.
observations.evidence: status=passed, case_count=4, assertion_error_count=0, cases: publishable-executes-send, unknowns-publish-nothing, invented-citation-refuses, needs-source

observations.claim: The skill reads the incident from a live source rather than accepting pasted fragments.
observations.evidence: web.fetch of https://raw.githubusercontent.com/NidhalxMRR/postmortem-maker-fixtures/main/incident-checkout.txt at 2026-09-11T13:47:36.949Z, source_digest sha256:73528990f99b196e626f5f14f830933d912129e2a9e91655c6105eabc53bbad2, 4 fragments derived at run time

observations.claim: An authorised publish is executed in the same run, not merely proposed.
observations.evidence: publish_performed=true, publish_result.executed=true, channel=status-page, audience=customers, delivery_skill=send-as, body_chars=1251, body_digest=fnv1a:dd96ccabeac9a5f6

observations.claim: The dogfood run produced a sealed receipt that verifies valid.
observations.evidence: receipt sha256:cc88596974ab5536af2ac9facf2d456a6a1fa0d06d582ac776ff79f1b27c7813; verify verdict valid=true, digest valid, content_address valid, signature valid

observations.claim: An invented citation refuses the whole run instead of publishing an unsupported claim.
observations.evidence: harness case postmortem-maker-invented-citation-refuses seals decision=refused with an empty timeline and publish_result=null
harness case postmortem-maker-unknowns-publish-nothing seals decision=needs_more_evidence with publish_result=null

observations.claim: runx CLI version used exceeds the required minimum of 0.6.14.
web.fetch text extraction flattens newlines, which the harness caught as a real defect.
observations.evidence: extract=text returned the 3-line incident as one line; a naive newline split produced a single unciteable fragment and the run refused. segmentSource now splits ahead of embedded clock times so each event stays citable.
observations.command: runx skill runx/web-fetch --registry https://api.runx.ai -i url=<fixture> -i extract=text --json

details.publish_method: runx login --provider github --for publish --from-gh, then runx registry publish ./skills/postmortem-maker --registry https://api.runx.ai

source_read.note: fragments derived at run time from the fetched text, not passed in by the caller

details.impact: checkout 5xx rate crossed the 8 percent alert threshold until rollback restored baseline

action_items.action: Add connection pool saturation alerting that fires before the customer-facing 5xx threshold.
Gate connection pool changes behind a staged rollout with automatic rollback on 5xx regression.
